wd4-trimbelle-zopp.st: A 1912 wire report called him an eccentric blacksmith who 'secreted' a fortune estimated at $20,000 about his home; the 1912 searches were futile.
src: Portage Daily Register, 20 Jun 1912, p. 1 (wire brief; also in Merrill, Beaver Dam, Madison and Austin MN papers)

tw-mulchrone-liberty-pole-1899.st: In Feb. 1900 a large gang tore out the foundation walls of the old homestead where he was murdered, believing he had money concealed about the premises; no find reported.
